1A_low_dice_stratum.method: bottom decile of Dice, computed per model from all 280 clean-v3 KUB VAL cases
1A_low_dice_stratum.quantile_implementation: np.quantile(values, 0.10) default 'linear' interpolation, float64 (matches historical method)
1A_low_dice_stratum.note: do NOT force exactly 28 cases if ties produce more

1B_historical_replication_anchor.scope: replication of historical single-model failure strata ONLY
1B_historical_replication_anchor.main_analysis: all four models remain in the main clean-v3 failure analysis

1C_shared_failure.rule: UNet low AND Attention U-Net low AND UNet++ low AND DeepLabV3+ low (each by its own clean-v3 bottom-decile flag)

1D_architecture_disagreement.measure: dice_range = max(model Dice) - min(model Dice) on the same case
1D_architecture_disagreement.authorized_qualitative: deterministic top-4 by dice_range desc then sample_id asc (diagnostic view only)

1E_hd95_stratum.method: Q90 computed using ONLY hd95_valid == true cases
1E_hd95_stratum.invalid_handling: invalid HD95 cases explicitly flagged; never silently dropped from population accounting

1F_fp_burden.concept: high FP-component burden in evaluation-512 component space
1F_fp_burden.method: recompute clean-v3 Q90 of UNet++ fp_eval_components (historical decile method)
1F_fp_burden.historical_integer_4: v2 provenance only; NOT automatically frozen

1G_pixel_error_extension.constraint: descriptive only; do NOT redefine historical Phase-11 failure strata; no deployment/tuning thresholds

1I_phase12_reference_model.note: UNet++ anchor does NOT imply Phase-12 reference selection; Part 1B returns evidence only
